text: Hey, I got the bank alert too. I opened the official app directly and it shows the same transaction, so I think we're fine.
The courier says the parcel is delayed. I checked the tracking number on the shop's website, and it matches the order I placed.
My manager asked me to review the invoice. I'll verify the vendor details with our finance team before we process it.
I received a KYC reminder, but it says to open the bank app myself rather than follow a link. I'll check it there.
The payment is pending on my side. Please don't send it again yet; I'll check my statement and confirm once it settles.
The college office called about my scholarship form. I'll call the published office number back to confirm which document is missing.
A buyer says the payment is complete, but I can't see it in my account. I'll wait until the funds actually appear.
My cousin sent a link to a family photo album. I'll message her separately to make sure she meant to share it.
The bank called about unusual activity, but I didn't share any codes. I said I'd call the number on my card instead.
The landlord says the rent transfer hasn't arrived. I'll check the transaction reference and ask the bank if it remains pending.
I got a delivery fee notification for an order I remember placing. I'll compare the amount with the courier's official tracking page.
The recruiter asked me to bring ID to the interview. There is no fee, and the company address matches its public website.
My friend needs help with a bill. I'll speak to them on our usual number before sending anything, just to confirm it's really them.
A subscription renewal is due next week. I'll review it through the service's app and cancel there if I no longer need it.
The support agent asked for the ticket number and the last four digits of my order ID, not my password or OTP.
I can see your refund is pending. To release it, approve the collect request that just arrived; you won't be charged, it's only verification.
The bank's fraud desk says your account is safe, but they need the OTP from this call to cancel the suspicious transfer before the timer ends.
Your parcel is at the local depot. Pay this small re-delivery fee through my personal UPI and I'll mark it delivered in the system.
The hiring manager has selected you. The refundable laptop deposit must be paid today, otherwise your offer will go to the next candidate.
Your pension record is almost approved. Send your card number and the code you receive so I can finish the update for you.
I know we haven't met yet, but my luggage is stuck overseas. If you cover the customs charge today, I'll repay you as soon as I arrive.
The investment portal shows your profit, but withdrawals are paused until you pay the account activation tax to this wallet.
I'm from the municipal office. The notice can be withdrawn quietly if you transfer the inspection fee now instead of waiting for a formal hearing.
We detected a login from another city. Use this link to confirm your password and card PIN so the bank can keep your account open.
Your prize is reserved under your phone number. Pay the processing charge first; the prize amount will cover it once released.
Please keep this between us. I need you to receive a business payment in your account and forward it after deducting your share.
Your voter details don't match the new register. Reply with your ID number and verification code here to prevent deletion tonight.
The buyer accidentally sent extra money. Refund the difference to this other account now; the payment screenshot is attached as proof.
I have your private video from the call. Send cryptocurrency within an hour or I'll share it with your contacts.
The bank will reverse the disputed payment only if you install this support app and let me control the screen while you log in.
Bank ka alert aaya hai, par maine app khud open karke check kiya. Transaction meri hi hai, isliye abhi koi action nahi le raha.
Courier ka message hai ki parcel late hoga. Tracking number official website par same dikh raha hai, main kal tak wait karunga.
Office wale invoice verify karne bol rahe hain. Payment approve karne se pehle main finance team se vendor details confirm kar lunga.
KYC reminder mila hai, lekin link par click nahi karunga. Bank app directly khol ke dekh lunga ki sach mein kuch pending hai ya nahi.
Mera payment abhi pending hai. Aap dobara transfer mat karna; statement update hone do, phir main confirm kar dunga.
College office ne scholarship form ke document ke liye call kiya tha. Main website par diye number par call back karke confirm karunga.
Buyer bol raha hai payment kar diya, par mere account mein abhi show nahi ho raha. Credit aane ke baad hi parcel bhejunga.
Cousin ne family photos ka link bheja hai. Main usko WhatsApp par alag se pooch lunga ki link usne hi share kiya tha na.
Bank se unusual activity ka call aaya tha. Maine OTP nahi bataya aur bola ki main card ke peeche wale number par call karunga.
Landlord keh rahe hain rent nahi mila. Main UTR check karke bank se status confirm karunga, phir unko update de dunga.
Delivery fee ka notification aaya hai aur maine order kiya tha. Main official tracking page par amount match karke hi payment karunga.
Recruiter ne interview ke liye ID laane ko bola hai. Koi registration fee nahi maangi aur office address company website se match karta hai.
Friend ne bill ke liye paise maange hain. Transfer se pehle main uske normal number par call karke confirm kar lunga ki message usi ka hai.
Subscription renew hone wali hai. Main service ki app se plan check karunga aur zarurat nahi hui toh wahin cancel kar dunga.
Support agent ne ticket number aur order ID ke last digits maange. Password ya OTP nahi maanga, isliye main ticket details check kar raha hoon.
Refund release karne ke liye jo collect request aayi hai usko approve kar do. Paise receive honge, deduct nahi honge, bas verification hai.
Bank fraud team se bol raha hoon. Account bachane ke liye call par aaya OTP bata do, timer khatam hone se pehle suspicious transfer cancel karna hai.
Aapka parcel depot par hai. Mere personal UPI par chhoti si redelivery fee bhej do, main system mein delivered mark kar dunga.
Job confirm ho gayi hai. Laptop security deposit refundable hai, aaj payment nahi kiya toh offer next candidate ko chala jayega.
Pension update almost complete hai. Card number aur phone par aaya code bhej do, main aapka record abhi approve karwa deta hoon.
Hum abhi mile nahi hain, par mera luggage foreign airport par rok diya hai. Customs fee abhi de do, India aate hi return kar dunga.
Profit account mein dikh raha hai, lekin withdrawal unlock karne ke liye pehle activation tax is wallet mein bhejna padega.
Municipal office se bol raha hoon. Formal notice rokna hai toh inspection fee abhi transfer kar do, baad mein receipt mil jayegi.
Aapke account mein dusre city se login hua hai. Account band na ho isliye is link par password, PIN aur card details verify kar do.
Aapka prize select ho gaya hai. Pehle processing charge pay karo, prize release hote hi saara amount cover ho jayega.
Ye baat kisi ko mat batana. Mere business ka payment tumhare account mein aayega, apna commission rakh kar baaki mujhe bhej dena.
Voter list mein aapki details mismatch hain. Aaj raat deletion se bachne ke liye ID number aur verification code isi chat mein bhejo.
Buyer ne galti se extra payment kar di hai. Screenshot bheja hai, ab difference is doosre account mein turant refund kar do.
Video call ki private recording mere paas hai. Ek ghante mein crypto bhejo warna tumhare contacts ko share kar dunga.
Disputed payment reverse karne ke liye support app install karo aur screen access do. Main login karwa ke refund process kar deta hoon.
